name: Harborside Cuisine
notes: 3 photos, all menu boards. Photos show two different print versions of the same menu (older laid-out card vs. newer decorative reprint) with some overlapping sections at slightly different prices (e.g. Laab, Intestine Soup) and a few items renamed (Fried Tilapia -> Fried Riverbarb Fish). Merged by taking the newer reprint for overlapping sections (Appetizers, Steam Appetizers, Snacks, Cold Items, Salad, Laab, Dipping Sauce, Rice, Soup) and adding the sections only present on the older card (Wok, Rice Dishes, Curry) plus a couple items only on the older card (Chili Oil, Spare Rib Pho, Steam Rice). Beverages/soda section omitted as drink-only.
